title: console tooling standup - 2026-04-28
content:
Meeting: Console & Tooling standup
Date: 2026-04-28
Attendees: Asha Mehta (PM), Michael Chen (Frontend), Lina Gómez (Analytics), Raj Patel (Backend), Simone Li (SRE)

Highlights:
- UI: Michael: landed modal redesign for rollout config (PR #874). Visual QA passed; a11y keyboard focus issue discovered and reproduced. Accessibility fixes planned and small CSS change identified. Plan to add e2e a11y test.
- Rollouts: Raj: canary routing v2 ready; autoscaling profiles tuned to reduce CPU thrash. Canary targets set to 5% traffic for us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Rollout orchestration tested in staging with synthetic traffic.
- Analytics: Lina: added per-route latency histograms and token-cost attribution. Dashboards updated; query perf optimized. Retention window for rollout metrics set to 90 days. Added annotations for rollout start/stop.

Blockers:
- Accessibility: keyboard focus trap in modal prevents keyboard-only users from interacting with rollout form. Blocks wide rollout.
- Staging canary not getting traffic in eu-west-1 due to TLS mismatch on LB (staging cert chain). Simone/SRE investigating.

Decisions:
- Proceed with limited canary (5%) on us-west-2 for mobile web only on 2026-05-01 if a11y fix merged and staging smoke tests pass.
- Hold full UI rollout until keyboard focus fix merged and automated a11y test added to CI.

Action items:
- Michael Chen: fix keyboard focus behavior, add e2e a11y test, open follow-up PR (target: 2026-04-30). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/874
- Raj Patel & Simone Li: root-cause TLS mismatch in staging (eu-west-1) and deploy cert fix; update ticket JIRA-CR-1298 by 2026-04-29.
- Lina Gómez: add per-request token-cost chart and annotate with rollout timestamps; publish to shared dashboard (target: 2026-05-02).
- Asha Mehta: draft rollout comms for CS and Support with rollback playbook (due: 2026-04-30).

Notes & Links:
- Rollout plan (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/CON-341-console-rollout-plan
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/874
- Jira ticket: JIRA-CR-1298
- Slack: #console-rollouts (internal thread for canary)

Quick wins / Parking lot:
- Add audit log entry for rollout-by-user in console events (parking: 2026-05 sprint).
- Investigate adding token-cost smoke tests to CI to prevent regressions in analytics pipeline.

Next standup: 2026-05-05
